title: Share of people with visible red hair, by region

source.name: Red hair prevalence estimates compiled from genetics literature and population surveys
source.publisher: Encyclopedic/genetics-research compilation (Wikipedia-derived; Britain's DNA 2013 ancestry study)

notes: Roughly 1-2% of the world's population has naturally red hair. Ireland and Scotland have the highest concentrations; commonly cited figures put Ireland around 10% and Scotland around 13%, though exact rates vary by source and survey method.
